newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU raises 96/97 beet sugar crop to 15.92 mln tns.
newsitem.headline: EU raises 96/97 beet sugar crop to 15.92 mln tns.

text.p: The European Commission on Thursday raised its 1996/97 beet sugar production estimate to 15.92 million tonnes, from 15.58 million on December 12.
The crop totalled 15.64 million tonnes last season.
The revised balance sheet presented to the European Union's sugar management committee on Wednesday showed an increase in Italy's production estimate by 85,000 tonnes to 1.41 million tonnes.
Belgium revised its estimate up 14,000 tonnes to 930,000 and the Netherlands raised its estimate by 25,000 tonnes to one million.
Greece was up 5,000 tonnes to 265,000 tonnes.
The increases follow an announcement by France on Monday that it was raising its beet production estimate by 150,000 tonnes to 4.2 million tonnes.
The latest estimates have increased the amount of sugar available for export to 1.84 million tonnes.

The latest revisions have increased all quota amounts. "A" sugar is up to 11.73 million tonnes from 11.72 million, "B" quota is up to 2.44 million tonnes from 2.39 million, and "C", non-quota, sugar is up to 2.74 million tonnes from 2.48 million.
